title: Jobs People Do
goal: Students can identify common jobs, describe what people do, and express what they want to be.
goal_vi: Học sinh có thể nhận biết các nghề nghiệp phổ biến, mô tả công việc của mọi người và bày tỏ mong muốn nghề nghiệp của mình.

patterns.pattern: What do you do? I am a/an (job).
patterns.vi: Bạn làm nghề gì? Tôi là một (nghề nghiệp).
examples: What do you do? I am a teacher.
What do you do? I am a student.
What do you do? I am a chef.

patterns.vi: Anh ấy/Cô ấy là một (nghề nghiệp).
examples: He is a doctor.
She is a police officer.
My dad is a farmer.
They are teachers.
My parents are farmers.
Look! They are builders.

patterns.vi: Một (nghề nghiệp) giúp chúng ta bằng cách (hành động).
examples: A doctor helps us by healing sick people.
A teacher helps us by teaching new things.
A firefighter helps us by putting out fires.

patterns.vi: Một (nghề nghiệp) làm việc tại/trong một (địa điểm).
examples: A nurse works in a hospital.
A chef works at a restaurant.
A librarian works in a library.

patterns.pattern: Can you (action)? Yes, I can./No, I can't.
patterns.vi: Bạn có thể (hành động) không? Có, tôi có thể./Không, tôi không thể.
examples: Can you fly a plane? No, I can't. A pilot can.
Can you build a house? Yes, I can build a small one.
Can you sing well? Yes, I can sing.

patterns.vi: Anh ấy/Cô ấy có một (dụng cụ).
examples: A doctor has got a stethoscope.
A police officer has got a uniform.
A builder has got a hard hat.

patterns.pattern: What is he/she doing? He/She is (verb-ing).
patterns.vi: Anh ấy/Cô ấy đang làm gì? Anh ấy/Cô ấy đang (hành động).
examples: What is she doing? She is teaching.
What is he doing? He is driving a delivery bike.
What is the chef doing? He is cooking.

grammar.title: Present Simple: To Be (I am, He/She is, They are)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'am,' 'is,' or 'are' with 'to be' to state someone's job or role. 'I' goes with 'am,' 'he/she' goes with 'is,' and 'they' goes with 'are.'
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'am,' 'is,' hoặc 'are' với động từ 'to be' để nói về nghề nghiệp hoặc vai trò của ai đó. 'I' đi với 'am,' 'he/she' đi với 'is,' và 'they' đi với 'are.'
examples: I am a student.
She is a nurse.
They are farmers.
My dad is an engineer.

grammar.title: Present Continuous (is/are + verb-ing)
grammar.explain_en: We use the present continuous to talk about actions happening right now. We use 'is' for singular subjects and 'are' for plural subjects, followed by a verb ending in -ing.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn để nói về các hành động đang xảy ra ngay bây giờ. Chúng ta dùng 'is' cho chủ ngữ số ít và 'are' cho chủ ngữ số nhiều, theo sau là động từ thêm -ing.
examples: He is building a house now.
The chef is cooking delicious food.
The children are playing outside.
What are you doing? I am learning English.

grammar.title: Can / Can't (Ability)
grammar.explain_en: 'Can' means able to do something. 'Can't' means not able to do something. We use 'can' or 'can't' before a base verb.
grammar.explain_vi: 'Can' có nghĩa là có thể làm được điều gì đó. 'Can't' có nghĩa là không thể làm được điều gì đó. Chúng ta dùng 'can' hoặc 'can't' trước động từ nguyên mẫu.
examples: A pilot can fly a plane.
I can't sing very well.
Can a doctor help sick animals? No, a vet can.
My mom can cook delicious meals.

grammar.title: Have got / Has got (Possession)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'have got' or 'has got' to talk about things people own or possess. 'I, you, we, they' use 'have got.' 'He, she, it' use 'has got.'
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'have got' hoặc 'has got' để nói về những thứ mà mọi người sở hữu. 'I, you, we, they' dùng 'have got.' 'He, she, it' dùng 'has got.'
examples: A doctor has got a white coat.
I have got a new uniform.
They have got many tools for their work.
My sister has got a beautiful voice.
grammar.right: ✅ A firefighter has got a helmet.
grammar.wrong: ❌ A firefighter have got a helmet.

readings.title: My Parents' Jobs
readings.text: Hello! My name is Ben. I am 8 years old. My mom is a teacher. She works at Green Primary School. She teaches English. She is very kind and smart. My dad is a builder. He builds houses. He works hard every day. He can build big and strong houses. My parents are very busy, but they love their jobs. They help our community in different ways. I love my mom and dad very much!

readings.title: A Day with Aunt Mai
readings.text: Linh loves animals. Today, she is visiting her Aunt Mai. Aunt Mai is a vet. She works at a small animal clinic in the city. Aunt Mai helps sick animals feel better. She has got many pets in her clinic today. Look! A small cat is meowing. Aunt Mai is giving the cat some medicine. The cat doesn't like it much, but it needs to get well. Next, she is checking a big dog's paw. The dog is very friendly. Aunt Mai is cleaning the dog's wound. Linh is watching everything carefully. She thinks Aunt Mai's job is very interesting because she can help many lovely animals every day. Linh wants to be a vet when she grows up too!

readings.title: Our Community Helpers
readings.text: In our community, many people work hard to help us every day. They are our community helpers! Let's meet some of them. First, there is Mr. Nam, a police officer. He keeps us safe. He directs traffic and helps people when they are lost. He has got a uniform and a whistle. Next, we have Ms. Hoa, a doctor. She works at the hospital. When we are sick, she examines us and gives us medicine. She uses a stethoscope to listen to our hearts. Doctors are very important because they help us stay healthy. Then, there is Mr. Minh, a firefighter. He is very brave! When there is a fire, he puts it out with his team. He drives a big red fire truck and uses a long hose. Firefighters save lives and homes. All these people have different jobs, but they all work together to make our community a wonderful and safe place for everyone.

listening.script:
Listen and choose the correct answer. / Lắng nghe và chọn đáp án đúng.

Hello, everyone! My name is Ms. Linh, and I'm going to tell you about some special people in our community. 

First, there's Mr. Ba. He wakes up early every day. He goes to his big field. He plants vegetables and fruits. He waters them carefully. He is a farmer. He helps us have fresh food.

Next, we have Ms. Thuy. She loves animals. She works in a clinic. Today, she is helping a small dog that has a sore paw. She cleans the paw gently. Ms. Thuy is a vet.

Look! There's Mr. Hai. He wears a blue uniform. He stands on the street and helps cars and motorbikes go safely. He is directing traffic now. Mr. Hai is a police officer.

Finally, let's talk about Ms. Lan. She is in a big building with many books. She helps children find interesting stories. She is quiet but very kind. She is a librarian. She helps us learn and read.

life_skill.title: APPRECIATE OUR COMMUNITY HELPERS
life_skill.intro: Many people work hard every day to make our community a better place. They help us in many ways, from keeping us safe to providing food and care. It's important to appreciate and respect them.
life_skill.intro_vi: Nhiều người làm việc chăm chỉ mỗi ngày để biến cộng đồng của chúng ta thành một nơi tốt đẹp hơn. Họ giúp đỡ chúng ta bằng nhiều cách, từ việc giữ an toàn cho chúng ta đến việc cung cấp thức ăn và chăm sóc. Điều quan trọng là phải biết trân trọng và tôn trọng họ.

life_skill.value_question: How can you show your appreciation to the community helpers around you?

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The word 'doctor' comes from a Latin word meaning 'to teach'!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết? Từ 'doctor' (bác sĩ) xuất phát từ một từ Latin có nghĩa là 'dạy dỗ'!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Firefighters don't just put out fires; they also help with car accidents and natural disasters!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết? Lính cứu hỏa không chỉ dập tắt đám cháy; họ còn giúp đỡ trong các vụ tai nạn ô tô và thiên tai!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Some police officers work with special dogs called K9 units to help them find things or people!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết? Một số cảnh sát làm việc với những chú chó đặc biệt gọi là đơn vị K9 để giúp họ tìm đồ vật hoặc người!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The tallest chef's hat ever recorded was over 4 feet (1.2 meters) tall!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết? Chiếc mũ đầu bếp cao nhất từng được ghi nhận cao hơn 1.2 mét!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? In some places, postmen deliver mail on bikes, boats, or even on skis!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết? Ở một số nơi, người đưa thư giao thư bằng xe đạp, thuyền hoặc thậm chí bằng ván trượt tuyết!

classroom_game.name: Job Charades
steps_en: Write different job names on small cards (e.g., doctor, chef, pilot).
Students sit in groups. One student picks a card and acts out the job without speaking.
Their group members guess the job.
The first group to guess correctly gets a point. Continue with new players and cards.
The group with the most points at the end wins.
steps_vi: Viết tên các nghề nghiệp khác nhau lên những tấm thẻ nhỏ (ví dụ: bác sĩ, đầu bếp, phi công).
Học sinh ngồi theo nhóm. Một học sinh chọn một tấm thẻ và diễn tả nghề nghiệp đó mà không nói.
Các thành viên trong nhóm đoán nghề nghiệp đó.
Nhóm nào đoán đúng đầu tiên sẽ được một điểm. Tiếp tục với người chơi và thẻ mới.
Nhóm nào có nhiều điểm nhất cuối cùng sẽ thắng.
